prompt: Create an original 180 second instrumental neo-soul instrumental composition for mystery, nocturnal exploration and restrained suspense. Mood: mysterious, tense, nocturnal. Instruments: electric piano, electric bass, clean guitar, drums. Style: pocket groove with syncopated seventh chords. Tempo approximately 78 BPM; G minor. Main idea: a descending melody with an upward answer. Use unresolved suspended harmony, careful space and subtle low-register movement; no jump scares. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-01:00] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [01:00-02:00] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [02:00-03:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 03:00.

description.en: A smooth and relaxed jazz-fusion track featuring a prominent piano melody, supported by a walking electric bass, light drums, and subtle synth pads and electric guitar fills. It has a sophisticated and chill lounge atmosphere.
description.zh: 一首流畅轻松的爵士融合乐曲，以突出的钢琴旋律为主，配以行进的电贝斯、轻柔的鼓点以及微妙的合成器铺垫和电吉他填充。营造出精致而悠闲的氛围。
